grammar.title: 胆战心惊
lines: 6 It is true that during their explorations they often faced difficulties and dangers of the most perilous nature , equipped in a manner which would make a modern climber shudder at the thought , but they did not go out of their way to court such excitement. * It is true that ..., but ... 诚然…但…(让步、转折经常用于议论文) It is true that China is still a developing country, but she is full of potential / potentialities. 诚然中国还是一个发展中国家，但她却充满潜力。 be faced / confronted with 面临着、面对着... But if the animals are confronted with situations they have no control over, they later behave passively when faced with experiences they can control. 六级阅读真题 of ... nature 某种类型的… 做后置定语，修饰前面的名词 be equipped with 装备上 in a manner 以…方式(a manner单数) at the … of … 【时间状语短语】一…就... Riot police were patrolling the stadium , equipped in a manner which would make a soccer hooligan shudder at the sight. 防暴警察在体育场外巡逻，装备得使足球流氓一看到就不寒而栗。 go out of one's way (to do ...) 不怕麻烦地 / 特意做… They had a single aim, a solitary goal -- the top! 同义词连用(重要的事情说三遍) a single aim, a solitary goal 唯一的目标（同义词连用，用于加强语气） 词语重复以加强语气 强调情感或语气
It was true that he had just bought a lamb, but his lamb was black . NCE3 L16
It is true that they faced danger, but they didn’t seek it. 诚然他们面对危险，但他们并非刻意追求。
It is true that she is young, but she is very competent. 诚然她很年轻，但她非常能干。
Admittedly, ..., but ... 诚然…但… Admittedly , I could have tried harder, but I still don't think all this criticism is fair. 诚然我本可以更努力，但我仍觉得这些批评不公平。
Granted, ..., but ... 诚然…但… Granted , he doesn't look too bad for his age, but I don't fancy him. 诚然他这个年纪看上去还不错，但我不喜欢他。
It is true that ..., but yet that is not to say that ... 这并不少说...
it does not follow that ... 这不一定得出这样的结论...
Admittedly, it does not necessarily mean that ... 这不对意味着...
we cannot ensure that … 不能保证…
Granted, it cannot guarantee that … 不能保证…
there is no guarantee that … 不能保证...
China is faced / confronted with the problem of overpopulation. 中国正面临人口过剩的问题。
They were faced / confronted with a serious economic crisis. 他们面临着严重的经济危机。
Animals confronted with uncontrollable situations may behave passively later. 动物在无法控制的情况下可能会表现出消极的行为。
I can’t approve of things of this nature . 这种事
treaties of a political nature 政治性的条约
books of an erotic nature 色情的书刊
questions of an academic nature 学术性的问题
articles of a technical nature 技术性的文章
dangers of the most perilous nature 极其危险的危险
The soldiers were equipped with night vision goggles. 士兵配备了夜视仪。
This car is equipped with the latest safety system. 这辆车配备了最新的安全系统。
The city was even equipped with a drainage system .
Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure .
He spoke in a manner that impressed everyone. 他说话的方式让所有人印象深刻。
She behaved in a manner not suitable for the occasion. 她的行为方式不适合这个场合。
The machine works in a manner that saves energy. 这台机器的工作方式很节能。
She screamed at the sight of the ghost. 一看到就…
She trembled at the thought of the murder. 一想到就…
She woke at the sound of the bell. 一听到就...
She fainted at the news of her father’s death. 一 获得（消息）就…
She wept at the mention of the accident. 一提到就…
at the thought of 一想到…就... He laughed at the thought of his childhood antics. 一想到小时候的恶作剧他就笑了。
at the idea of 一有 ... 念头就... ... your stomach would turn at the idea of frying potatoes in animal fat ...
the + adj. + mention of ... 一提到... 就... ... they always go into raptures at the mere mention of the country .
Please don't go out of your way for me. 请别为我特意麻烦。
It was very kind of you to go out of your way to meet us at the airport. 专门、专程
He went out of his way to help the new employee. 他特意去帮助那位新员工。
They went out of their way to welcome us. 他们不辞辛劳地欢迎我们。
She had a single aim, a solitary goal -- to win the championship. 她只有一个目标——赢得冠军。
He lived his life with a single aim, a solitary goal — to find the truth. 他一生的目标就是寻找真理。
The explorers pushed forward with a single aim, a solitary goal — the summit. 探险者们只有一个目标——登顶。
虚情假意、山盟海誓、千刀万剐、深仇大恨 中文举例
I'm sick and tired of your excuses / silliness. 我受够了你的借口。
She always complains of her aches and pains . 她总是抱怨这疼那疼。
He never wants to pick and choose . 他从不挑三拣四。

sentences.title: 登山先驱们
lines: 4 It is hard for us to realize nowadays how difficult it was for the pioneers . it is hard for sb. to do sth. sb.很难去做某事 Except for one or two places such as Zermatt and Chamonix, which had rapidly become popular , Alpine villages tended to be impoverished settlements cut off from civilization by the high mountains. except for / but for 除了 / 若没有... Insects would make it impossible for us to live in the world; they would devour all our crops and kill our flocks and herds, if it were not for the protection we get from insect-eating animals. Zermatt / Chamonix 地名：滑雪/登山胜地 tend to do 往往（常常）、倾向于（客观的趋势） settlements 居民点、村庄 (which were) cut off from civilization 与文明隔绝(相当于定语从句，定语的关系代词做主语，如果是Be动词，则可以同时省略) Such inns as there were were generally dirty and flea-ridden ; the food was simply local cheese accompanied by bread often 12 months old , all washed down with coarse wine. 并列句，省掉了谓语动词be（was） inn 乡下小旅馆 such / the same / as / so + 先行词 + as … 限定性定语从句（不用which和that） 并列句中谓语动词可省略 accompany vt.伴随（常见被动） wash down with 用…送(服)下 Often a valley boasted no inn at all, and climbers found shelter wherever they could --sometimes with the local priest ( who was usually as poor as his parishioners ), sometimes with shepherds or cheese-makers. boast （事物）拥有；（人）自夸 shelter 住处、庇护所（不可数） Invariably the background was the same: dirt and poverty, and very uncomfortable. 两个同位语 invariably 总是、不变地 For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home , the change to the Alps must have been very hard indeed. be accustomed to sth. / doing 习惯于做某事 法式套餐之7道菜 常识 每日习语 Barking up the wrong tree 找错了对象，抓错了重点
It is hard for me to believe that he did this.
It is hard for students to concentrate during long lectures.
It is hard for animals to survive in extreme weather conditions.
Except for your help, I couldn’t have finished the project. 若没有你的帮助，我无法完成这个项目
But for the rain, we would have gone hiking. 若不是下雨，我们就去远足了
I would buy a Mercedes except / but (that) I am poor. 真实（接宾语从句后面的for要去掉）
I would buy a Mercedes if I were rich. 虚拟

except for / but for / if it were not for … 若没有……的话（虚拟语气） If it were not for her advice, I would be lost. 若没有她的建议，我就迷路了。 Except for / But for / If it were not for your support, I would be in big trouble now.
Zermatt is a famous ski resort in Switzerland. Zermatt是瑞士著名的滑雪胜地
Chamonix is the cradle of modern mountaineering. Chamonix是现代登山的发源地
People tend to need less sleep when they get older.
Women tend to live longer than men.
People tend to trust familiar brands. 人们往往信任熟悉的品牌
Teenagers tend to stay up late. 青少年往往熬夜
We tend to forget things when we're tired. 我们疲惫时往往会忘事
have a tendency to do 倾向于做某事 The drug has a tendency to cause dizziness / headaches. 这药有引起头晕的倾向
in most cases 多数情况下 In most cases , the software works fine. 多数情况下这软件运行良好
by and large 总的来说 By and large , he is a good student. 总的来说，他是个好学生
generally 普遍地 It is generally believed that... 人们普遍相信...
In general 通常，一般来说 This hobby educates one not only in the chosen subject, but also in general matters which have some bearing on it .
mostly adv.多半，主要地；几乎全部/所有 The audience were mostly adolescents. 听众几乎都是年轻人.
on the whole 总体来说 Today we tend to go to the other extreme, but on the whol e this is a healthier attitude both for the child and the parent .
for the most part 多半 The contributors are, for the most part , professional scientists. 投稿者大多是专业科学家。
most of the time 大多数时候 It's crazy here most of the time . 这儿经常吵吵闹闹的。
Many settlements were established near rivers. 许多居民点建立在河流附近
The early settlements faced harsh conditions. 早期居民点面临恶劣环境
These small settlements gradually turned into towns. 这些小村落逐渐变成了城镇
out of touch with civilization 脱离文明 They were out of touch with civilization for months. 他们几个月与文明隔绝
isolated from civilization 被文明隔绝 The tribe was isolated from civilization for centuries. 这个部落与文明隔绝了数百年
separated from civilization 与文明分离 The island remained separated from civilization . 这个岛一直与文明隔离
We stayed at a cozy inn in the mountains. 我们住在山里的一个舒适的小旅馆
The old inn has been turned into a museum. 这家老旅馆被改成了博物馆
They opened a new inn near the hiking trail. 他们在徒步小径附近开了家新旅馆
I need the same tool as you are using . / I need such a tool as you are using . / I need as useful a tool as you are using .
I want such a phone as you have . 我想要你那种手机
She needs the same book as I read . 她需要我读过的那本书
We admire such people as help others . 我们敬佩那些帮助他人的人
…; the food (was) simply local cheese accompanied by bread often 12 months old.
… ,for a spider always has eight legs and an insect never (has) more than six .
Paul likes poetry, and Peter (likes) fiction.
Paul likes poetry, and I know that Peter likes fiction .
The disease is accompanied by sneezing and fever.
strong winds accompanied by heavy rain 非谓语
The fever is accompanied by a severe cough. 发烧伴随着严重咳嗽
Success is often accompanied by stress. 成功常伴随压力
The meal was accompanied by fine wine. 这顿饭配上了美酒
We ate some sausage, and washed it down with whiskey.
He washed down the pill with water. 他用水把药咽了下去。
She washed the meal down with beer. 她用啤酒把这顿饭吃下去。
They washed down the cake with coffee. 他们用咖啡吃下蛋糕。
The town boasts a rich history. 这座城拥有丰富的历史
The school boasts excellent facilities. 这所学校拥有一流设施
He boasts of his achievements constantly. 他总是夸耀自己的成就
find one’s way 人做主语；表示“找到道路” Specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way . （鬼做主语）
事物做主语；表示“到达某地” My nephew, George, has a money box but it is always empty. Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there .
threaten to do （人做主语）威胁做某事 They threatened to kill him if he didn’t obey.
（物做主语）有…的威胁 Mining operations threaten to destroy our environment. We keep trying all four methods, but the sheer volume of rubbish we produce worldwide threatens to overwhelm us .
promise to do （人做主语）承诺做某事 He promised to call me every week.
（物做主语）有…的可能 It promises to be warm today. Groundbreaking research by two French geophysicists promises to shed some light on the mystery. 六级真题
Food , clothing , shelter and transportation are basic necessities of daily life. 衣食住行【不可数】
They found shelter under a tree. 他们在树下找到了避难处
Many refugees need food and shelter . 许多难民需要食物和住处
The cave provided shelter from the storm. 山洞为他们挡住了风暴
Invariably , he arrives late. 他总是迟到
Invariably , the result is the same. 结果总是一样的
Invariably , she chooses chocolate. 她总是选巧克力
Men accustomed to struggling for survival against the elements and Indians were bewildered by politicians, bankers and businessmen, and unhorsed by fences, laws and alien taboos .
He is accustomed to working late. 他习惯了晚工作
She is accustomed to the cold . 她习惯了寒冷
They are accustomed to city life . 他们习惯了城市生活
be used to sth. / doing I am used to traveling by air, and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened .
be in the habit of sth. / doing I'm not in the habit of letting strangers into my apartment. 我不习惯让陌生人进我家。
